purpose: rollback to stock rothko super + vendor_boot
recovery_notes: Android mode: /sdcard/work/rollback is writable by shell (FUSE); adb push there
recovery (OrangeFox): mount /data then use /data/media/0/work/rollback; abort without writing if data is not mounted/decrypted
order: verify both images sha256 -> dd super -> dd vendor_boot -> sync -> full read-back sha256 -> PASS/FAIL -> reboot
vendor_boot restores current slot only (ro.boot.slot_suffix, currently _a); optional --both-slots
